title: Widely spaced horizontal members.
officialText:
Where the barrier is composed of horizontal and vertical members and the
distance between the tops of the horizontal members is 45 inches (1143 mm) or more, spacing between vertical members shall
not exceed 4 inches (102 mm). Where there are decorative cutouts within vertical members, spacing within the cutouts shall not
exceed 1¾ inches (44 mm) in width.
